name: Illusrigare
source:
Welcome to Illusrigare, mysterious city overflowing with water!
Why have you woken up in such a strange city? Why, to find someone you cherish! Someone you can't seem to remember...
And yet, you know that they are here, in this city.

In your journey to find the person you are looking for—meeting and getting to know the people in the city along the way—you may start to remember other things from your past. Some of which you may not have wanted—or just wasn't ready—to remember.

In the end, will you be able to confront what happened in your past?


A story of two people who've been separated, being able to meet each other again.

[From [url=https://user2002chr.itch.io/illusrigare]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到Illusrigare，充满水的神秘城市！
为什么你会在这么陌生的城市醒来？为什么，要找到一个你珍惜的人！一个你似乎不记得的人…
然而，你知道他们就在这里，在这座城市。

在寻找你​​要找的人的旅程中——一路上遇见并了解城市里的人们——你可能会开始记起你过去的其他事情。其中一些你可能不想——或者只是还没准备好——记住。

最后，你能面对过去发生的事情吗？


讲述两个分开的人，再次相遇的故事。

[来自[url=https://user2002chr.itch.io/illusrigare]itch.io[/url]]
